'''Eibon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. One of the original member-worlds of the [[Kingdom of Cron]], it was absorbed into [[Xim's empire]]. A planet known for its proud and independent people, [[Xer VIII]] and his son [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] respected Eibon, and one of Xim's [[Flagship/Legends|flagships]] was named the ''[[Eibon Scimitar]]''. After Xim's empire collapsed, Eibon would continue to thrive as a world, and when it joined the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]] after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was considered one of the most powerful worlds of the Cron region.
